name: Wockhardt Limited
remarksWeb: 1. The total Equity Share Capital of the Company comprises of 11,05,96,828 Equity Shares of Rs. 5/- each which includes ?Shares underlying DRs?. Hence, for the purpose of calculation of % for the column ?Shareholding as a % of total no. of shares (calculated as per SCRR, 1957)?, the Company has considered  11,05,96,828 (i.e. Total No. of Equity Shares as above) as denominator. 2. The Company has issued 121,454,927 Optionally Convertible Cumulative Redeemable Preference Shares (OCCRPS). These OCCRPS are held by one of the promoters of the Company and four banks.  In the column ?No. of Shares Underlying Outstanding convertible securities (including Warrants)?, actual no. of Shares that will be allotted to OCCRPS holders have been mentioned on the assumption of full conversion of OCCRPS. Further, shareholding as a % assuming full conversion of convertible securities of the Company (OCCRPS) is arrived at taking the conversion price of Rs. 1112.03 (i.e. Conversion Price of Rs. 1112.03 is as on 4th June 2016, which is Relevant Date). Hence, the denominator for the purpose of calculation of percentage in this column is the enhanced Capital (i.e. Total No. of Fully paid up Equity shares held as on 31/12/2017 plus Equity Shares that will arise assuming full conversion of OCCRPS). 3. Khorakiwala Holdings and Investments Private Limited (KHIPL) holds 18,528,540 Nos. of OCCRPS of Rs. 5/- each. 102,926,387 Nos. of OCCRPS are held by 4 Banks. 4. The shares appearing under "Bodies Corporate" in Table II are held by the said Companies (excluding Khorakiwala Holdings and Investments Private Limited (KHIPL) in capacity as a trustee of trusts being partner in partnership firms. 5. The shares appearing under "Promoter Trust" in Table II are held by the said Companies in the capacity as a Trustee of Respective Trusts. 6. NEAPS system has not captured shares under row Shares underlying GDRs as part of Total Share Capital in all the Tables under Column ?Shareholding as a % of total no. of shares (calculated as per SCRR, 1957)?. Hence, there is a minor difference in the % of Shareholding as appearing on NSE portal and the actual Shareholding Pattern. [As on 31.12.17, % shares held by Promoters: 74.13%, Public: 25.78% & GDR: 0.09%] 5. KHIPL holding 18,528,540 Nos. of OCCRPS falls under Promoter and Promoter Group. [As on 31.12.2017, total no. of Promoter Shareholders holding securities of the Company: 13] 6. In Table III under Institutions, Foreign Portfolio Investors include 5 shareholders holding 6,096 shares held by Foreign Institutional Investors. 7. In Table III under Non-Institutions, a. 4 shareholders holding 57,100 shares under ?Any Other Category- Other? belongs to Directors/Relatives of Directors. b. 558 shareholders holding 1,88,306 number of shares under ?Any Other Category- Non Resident Indians ? belongs to Non-Repatriable category of Non-Resident Indians. c. 1487 shareholders holding 7,85,460 number of shares under ?Any Other Category- Non Resident Indians ? belongs to Repatriable category of Non-Resident Indians. 8. In Table I, NEAPS system does not allow to punch the percentage 0.09 in the row ?Shares underlying GDRs? under Column ?Shareholding , as a % assuming full conversion of convertible securities ( as a percentage of diluted share capital). Hence the total percentage is reflecting as 99.91 instead of 100%.
